pr_title: Properly handle theme changes in the Skeleton3DEditor
pr_body: Fixes https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/65037. Pretty much described in my comment there.

issue_context.title: Skeleton bones have invalid icons
issue_context.body:
### Godot version

v4.0.alpha.custom_build [e60086f98]

### System information

Arch on 5.19.2-arch1-1

### Issue description

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/14253836/187203737-e72ddbb8-1a61-4d00-b9d9-ef7631be6e9c.png)


### Steps to reproduce

Open MRP, right click mesh, new inherited scene, click skeleton

### Minimal reproduction project

Just copied this MRP from # 56458
[BoneAABBWarnings.zip](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/files/9444587/BoneAABBWarnings.zip)
comments:
> Maybe related by #65044 or #63358?

Very unlikely.

It's probably a regression from https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/62845. `Skeleton3DEditor` doesn't seem to have any code that would react on the editor theme changes. Instead it only updates itself on enter tree. And after https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/62845 we don't have the theme available on ENTER_TREE.

While this is technically a regression from https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/62845, the solution is to properly handle THEME_CHANGED notification, as does the rest of the editor.

Edit: I'll patch it soon, btw.

review_comments: Nitpick, but we try to keep a separation like between `case`s for `_notification` switches, as these are often big/method-sized scopes.
But this code already didn't follow that convention so let's not make it block a regression fix.
